name: request_routing_before_task_training
success_metric: Track users who receive a relevant next step after non-task requests or device clarification; audit incorrect routing and unanswered clarification questions.
acceptance: Health, emotional, relationship and unclear requests do not automatically become procrastination analysis.
Health replies do not diagnose or select medication; existing crisis handling precedes all routing.
Device clarification waits for a reply; computer distractions select a computer action.
Anxiety and overload do not default to body-first without reported physiological load.
